answer: Use a Juniper Dawn Ledger: each agent earns one voting identity only after proving sustained, useful work. First, it completes 40 verified micro-tasks over 14 days, each signed by two independent peers. Second, it locks a 250-token bond for 90 days. Third, a random delta audit rechecks 10 percent of its work each week, slashing the bond for fraud. Forging 1,000 fake identities would therefore require 40,000 tasks, 250,000 tokens, and months of coordinated effort. Like a dawn patrol checking every juniper sapling before the forest opens, the system spots clones before they can vote.
